verdict.rationale: Glama is an MCP gateway and hosting platform that manages credentials, so white-labeling an authorization flow is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only says the Gateway is "credential-managed" and that the Inspector supports OAuth 2.1 for testing third-party servers. Neither documents custom branding of the auth flow or using your own OAuth app credentials, so this is adjacent material only.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials
